text:
sophie (Support): Heads-up: new customer Greenline just finished SSO onboarding but reports no API key visible in their project. They tried to call the API and get 401. I'm looping folks in to triage. org_id: org_gl_82, contact: tony@greenline.com

kevin (CSM): ack. any error payloads from their curl? which env/project are they using?

sophie (Support): They use project `gl-main` in our console. Sample call they ran:

```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"mix-medium","input":"hi"}'
```

Response: `{"error":"Unauthorized","message":"no API key provided or key invalid"}` (HTTP 401). They say nothing shows under Console → Projects → gl-main → API keys (empty list).

kevin (CSM): did they use the Console create flow or expect a pre-provisioned key after SSO?

sophie (Support): They expected an automatic key provisioning flow (we have that for some SSO/onboard templates). I checked internal provisioning events and see a key create event for the org, but the binding looks wrong. snippet from our internal audit log:

```
{ event: "api_key.created", org_id: "org_gl_82", key_id: "rn_placeholder", bound_project: "prod-legacy", status: "active" }
```
so the system created a key but attached it to `prod-legacy` (legacy default project) instead of `gl-main`. The console only shows keys scoped to gl-main so Greenline sees nothing.

luis (Provisioning): interesting — we recently changed the SCIM->project mapping defaults for new orgs (rollout flag: scim_project_map_v2). Looks like org_gl_82 hit the new code path but their SCIM group mapping included an empty `project` attribute, stale fallback picked `prod-legacy`. I'll dig in.

anya (Account Ops): quick question: is billing enabled for org_gl_82? sometimes the UI hides the create-key button when billing not attached. Sophie, can you confirm what the console shows in the admin tenant?

sophie (Support): In admin view I see `billing_state: pending-setup`. The create-key button in the customer's UI was greyed out. But the audit log still shows a key event (the one luis found) — suspicious mix of flows.

mike (SRE): two parallel problems then: 1) auto-provision bound to wrong project, 2) console UX hides manual create when billing is pending. Which explains why they have a key but can't see it or create another.

luis (Provisioning): probable fix path: re-bind the existing key to gl-main and flip the fallback behavior for SCIM mappings. Short term, we can re-issue a key bound to the correct project and send to customer. Long term: patch scim_project_map_v2 to treat empty attribute as explicit `null` and choose org's default project instead of `prod-legacy`.

sophie (Support): would we need Account Ops to attach billing before I can create a manual key via Console? Or can we create via admin CLI and it will bypass the billing UI check?

anya (Account Ops): we can attach billing quickly if needed (I have the billing token from finance). But admin CLI creates keys irrespective of billing; it's an internal operation. Which do you prefer?

kevin (CSM): quicker to get the customer unblocked with an admin-created key and explain we'll rotate it once billing is attached. Tony wants to test within the hour.

luis (Provisioning): OK I'll create a correctly bound key through the provisioning backend. Command I used (example):

```
# internal helper (admin-only)
rwdctl provision api-key create --org org_gl_82 --project gl-main --scopes "completions:read,completions:invoke" --note "temp onboarding key"
# returns: key_id=rn_temp_ABC (value is only shown once)
```
I'll post the key value to Sophie via secure channel after creation. I'll also patch the mapping logic and push a hotfix to disable scim_project_map_v2 for new orgs until we validate.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: provisioning-service patch (scim fallback) -> staging, ETA 20m

mike (SRE): when you create the key please also check event streams to confirm no duplicate bindings exist. If there is an active key in prod-legacy and we create another for gl-main, that's fine, but we should ensure principle of least privilege for the new key.

luis (Provisioning): noted. Also checked: the key bound to prod-legacy has `allowed_projects: [prod-legacy]` so it won't be usable from gl-main requests (hence 401). Good to rotate.

anya (Account Ops): I can attach billing while you're doing this. Setting `billing_account: BA_9812` on org_gl_82 now. Sophie, should open a support note to Tony so they know we're running behind the scenes.

sophie (Support): will do. Sending secure key to Tony now (one-time secret). pinging them to test.

kevin (CSM): Tony replied: ran same curl with new key, now 200 and completions returning. :tada: He says UI still doesn't show the key — that's expected because admin-created keys are not listed in the customer's UI for security, we'll document that.

sophie (Support): Confirmed closure: customer validated. Follow-ups: (1) luis to patch scim mapping fallback and rollout to prod, (2) anya to confirm billing flow hides create-key only when intended and add clearer tooltip, (3) ops to add a monitoring alert for mismatched key->project bindings during onboard.

luis (Provisioning): raising PR for mapping fix, pinging here when merged.

anya (Account Ops): filed ticket with product about create-key tooltip and billing UX (P:medium).

mike (SRE): wrote alert rule draft, will attach to the ticket.

sophie (Support): closing thread after notes saved in support case S-11945. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: provisioning-service patch deployed to staging successfully.

sophie (Support): (post-close) luis — please add a short blurb to the onboarding runbook about this fallback behavior so Support can triage faster next time.
